$comment: Settings for `validate` (scripts/ds-validate/). Paths are relative to this file, which lives in Code/.
Contract: Docs/Design system/design-in-code architecture.md. Record what you set here in 'Validation' in Code/ARCHITECTURE.md.
$tokenFiles: The generated token CSS. Never scanned.
$globalStylesheets: The global stylesheet: element defaults, type settings, resets, :root. Usually one file.
$manifest: The token manifest that `tokens` writes. Without it, Figma scope checks are off.
$allowedGlobalClasses: Utility classes that really are meant for use anywhere. Each needs `class` and `for`. Adding one is the design-system owner's decision; never add one to clear a scoping error.
$allowedValues: Extra literal values the value rules ignore, on top of 0, auto, inherit, initial, unset, revert, revert-layer, transparent, currentcolor, and none.
$allowedVariables: Non-token CSS variables a framework or tool sets, as name patterns (`*` matches any run of characters), for example "--tw-*".
$exemptions: Files allowed to break specific deviation rules, each with `files`, `rules`, and `why`. Scoping errors can't be exempted.
